{{Top}}
{{Quote|What're those big birds flying fast toward us?|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref>}}
[[File:SithWarbird.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A flightless Sith warbird]]
There were many kinds of '''birds''' or '''avians''' across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Bird was also a slang name for a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Typically birds could fly; however, there were some flightless [[Species/Legends|species]].

[[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]] avian species included the [[Calibop]]s,<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]],<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikks]], and the [[Hiitian/Legends|Hiitians]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
